SELECT distinct b.id, b.be_unauth, b.button_name, b.menu_id, m.menu_name as sub_menu, b.note, api.req_method, api.req_url, sbp.id as perm_id, sbp.perm_action, sbp.action_ref FROM sys_button_tenant b LEFT JOIN sys_menu_tenant m ON m.id = b.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_resource_api_tenant api ON b.id = api.resource_id AND api.resource_type = 'BUTTON' LEFT JOIN sys_business_perm_tenant sbp on sbp.button_id = b.id
AND (b.id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword,jdbcType=CHAR},'%') OR b.button_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword,jdbcType=CHAR},'%') OR api.req_url LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword,jdbcType=CHAR},'%') OR sbp.perm_action LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword,jdbcType=CHAR},'%') OR sbp.action_ref LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword,jdbcType=CHAR},'%'))
ORDER BY b.id desc LIMIT 5

SELECT distinct b.id, b.be_unauth, b.button_name, b.menu_id, m.menu_name as sub_menu, b.note, api.req_method, api.req_url FROM sys_button_tenant b LEFT JOIN sys_menu_tenant m ON m.id = b.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_resource_api_tenant api ON b.id = api.resource_id AND api.resource_type = 'BUTTON' WHERE b.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_button_tenant b LEFT JOIN sys_resource_api_tenant api ON b.id = api.resource_id AND api.resource_type = 'BUTTON' WHERE b.menu_id = #{menuId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
